documents.text: WorkUnit.final_state DONE means the work unit completed successfully; STOPPED means it ended without successful completion.

ActivityLog.result_code ERROR means that activity ended unsuccessfully, OK means it ended successfully, and RARE_SKIP is a permitted result code. An unsuccessful activity can occur within a DONE work unit.
An activity occurrence is identified by the complete tuple (site_ref, work_ref_ref, activity_id). The same activity_id may be used in a different work unit.

A ReplayRecord with site_ref and work_ref_ref matching an activity’s work unit and activity_ref matching that activity_id documents successful replay only when replay_state=REPLAYED. A replay for a different work unit or activity is not handling of this occurrence.
A WaiverRecord with site_ref and work_ref_ref matching an activity’s work unit and activity_ref matching that activity_id documents authorized handling only when waiver_state=AUTHORIZED.

These fields describe outcomes and handling records. The supplied definitions do not state that every unsuccessful activity must be replayed or waived, prohibit an unsuccessful activity in a completed work unit, or define an incident threshold.

question: The operational purpose is reviewing work units that finished successfully, rather than re-alerting overall unsuccessful work units. Within that population, propose useful factual non-statistical review checks from the field meanings and relationships. Select the actual conditions, source bindings and documented exceptions yourself. Do not invent a business prohibition or incident label.
